brief.question: Why do young women in cities struggle to find work?
brief.answer: In 2025 the unemployment rate for urban women aged 15‑29 was 18.9%, far above the 11.8% for their male peers (a gender gap of +7.1 points) and the 8.6% for rural women (an urban‑rural gap of +10.3 points). At the same time, their labour‑force participation was only 23.2%, 37.7 points lower than urban men (60.9%) and 6.1 points lower than rural women (29.3%). These high unemployment and very low participation rates together indicate that young urban women face a double disadvantage in the labour market.
